propositions: Four dispatch call sites reach for optional capability members (add_comment, set_relationship) using static cast() but perform no runtime guard, allowing AttributeError to be silently swallowed by a broad exception handler

When a transport lacks an optional capability, the mutation is never applied yet the pass reports success, conflating designed-skip with real failure and creating a silent data loss hazard that will surface when a second backend (DC) legitimately omits these capabilities

The capability absence must be runtime-guarded with isinstance() against @runtime_checkable Protocols before each call and logged distinctly via the existing bridge_alerts channel rather than swallowed

A proxying transport that forwards via __getattr__ will fail isinstance() on Python 3.12+ but succeed hasattr(), requiring a fallback member check to avoid false capability-absent alerts for wrapped transports
Module size constraint requires relocating _call_with_retry (~75 LOC) from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to accommodate guards without exceeding 800-LOC ceiling
